title: Build an AND circuit
description: Create a circuit whose output Y is 1 only when A and B are both 1.

title: AND into OR
description: Build Y = (A AND B) OR C.

title: NAND from AND and NOT
description: Build a NAND function using only AND and NOT gates: Y is 0 only when A and B are both 1.
hint: Invert the output of an AND gate.

title: XOR from AND, OR, NOT
description: Build Y = A XOR B (1 when exactly one input is 1) using AND, OR, and NOT gates.
hint: A XOR B = (A AND NOT B) OR (NOT A AND B).

title: Majority of three
description: Y is 1 when at least two of A, B, C are 1.
expected_expression: (A AND B) OR (A AND C) OR (B AND C)

title: 2-to-1 multiplexer
description: Y equals A when S is 0, and equals B when S is 1.
expected_expression: (A AND NOT S) OR (B AND S)

title: Half adder
description: Add two bits A and B. S is the sum bit and C is the carry bit.

title: Full adder
description: Add bits A, B and carry-in Cin. S is the sum bit and Cout the carry-out.

expected_outputs.Cout: (A AND B) OR (Cin AND (A XOR B))

title: Asynchronous 2-bit up counter (7476)
description: Build a ripple counter with a 7476 dual JK flip-flop: the first flip-flop is clocked by CLK, the second by the output of the first. After each clock pulse Q1 Q0 must read 01, 10, 11, 00, 01.
hint: Tie J, K, /PRE and /CLR of both flip-flops to VCC so each one toggles. The 7476 triggers on the falling edge, so clock the second flip-flop from the first one's Q.

title: Asynchronous 2-bit down counter (7476)
description: Build a ripple down counter with a 7476. Starting from 00, Q1 Q0 must read 11, 10, 01, 00, 11 after the clock pulses.
hint: Same as the up counter, but clock the second flip-flop from the first one's Q-bar (the inverted output).

title: Synchronous 2-bit up/down counter (7476)
description: Build a synchronous counter with a 7476 where both flip-flops share CLK. M = 0 counts up and M = 1 counts down. From 00: with M = 0 it reads 01, 10, 11, 00; then with M = 1 it reads 11, 10, 01, 00.
hint: The low bit toggles every pulse (J = K = 1). The high bit toggles when Q0 XOR M is 1.

title: 4-bit shift register (7474)
description: Build a serial-in shift register from two 7474 dual D flip-flops. DIN enters Q0 and each pulse moves the bits one place towards Q3. Applying DIN = 1, 0, 1, 1 on four pulses leaves Q3 Q2 Q1 Q0 = 1011.
hint: Chain the flip-flops: DIN to the first D, each Q to the next D, all clocks together. Tie /PRE and /CLR to VCC.

title: Verification of logic gates
description: Verify the basic gates: build AND, OR, NAND, NOR, XOR and XNOR of the two inputs A and B, each on its own output.

title: Simplify with Boolean algebra
description: F = A'B'C + A'BC + AB'C + ABC' + ABC. Simplify the equation using Boolean algebra, then build the simplified circuit.
hint: A'B'C + A'BC + AB'C + ABC = C. The remaining term ABC' combines with ABC to give AB.

title: Excess-3 to BCD code converter
description: Convert a 4-bit excess-3 code (E3 E2 E1 E0, valid for digits 3 to 12) to BCD (B3 B2 B1 B0). Use a K-map: the unused codes are don't-cares.
hint: Excess-3 = BCD + 3, so BCD = excess-3 - 3. Fill the K-map for each output, treating 0000-0010 and 1101-1111 as don't-cares.

title: BCD to Excess-3 code converter
description: Convert a BCD digit (D3 D2 D1 D0, valid for 0 to 9) to excess-3 (X3 X2 X1 X0). The codes 1010-1111 are don't-cares.
hint: Excess-3 = BCD + 3. Use a K-map per output and use the don't-cares to make groups larger.

title: Full adder with 8:1 multiplexers (74153)
description: Implement a full adder (S, Cout) using 8:1 multiplexers, each built from the two 4:1 halves of a 74153. Use A as the third select bit by enabling one half at a time.

expected_outputs.Cout: (A AND B) OR (Cin AND (A XOR B))

hint: Wire B and Cin to the shared select pins. Drive /1G with A and /2G with NOT A, tie each data input to VCC or GND from the truth table, and OR the two outputs 1Y and 2Y.

title: 2-bit comparator with 74138 decoders
description: Compare A = A1A0 with B = B1B0. Agt is 1 when A > B, Aeq when A = B, and Alt when A < B. Build it with 3:8 decoders (74138); use the enable pins to take the fourth input.
hint: Two 74138s make a 4:16 decoder: enable one when A1 = 0 and the other when A1 = 1. The outputs are active low, so combine the wanted minterms with a NAND gate.

title: SR latch with NAND gates
description: Build a set-reset latch from two cross-coupled NAND gates. S and R are active low: S = 0 sets Q to 1, R = 0 resets Q to 0, and S = R = 1 holds the value. Q and Qn are the two outputs.
hint: Q = NAND(S, Qn) and Qn = NAND(R, Q): feed the output of each gate back into the second input of the other.

title: Clocked SR flip-flop with NAND gates
description: Build a clocked SR flip-flop from four NAND gates: two gates that pass S and R only while CLK is 1, feeding a cross-coupled NAND latch. S = 1 sets Q, R = 1 resets Q, and S = R = 0 holds. Each step sets S and R, then gives one clock pulse.
hint: NAND(S, CLK) and NAND(R, CLK) feed a latch of two cross-coupled NAND gates: Q = NAND(first, Qn) and Qn = NAND(second, Q).
